mechanism.notes: the verified lead slipper-nose-knuckle-3r with the clock spring, its cap, the stop-A pin and the stage-1 MR63ZZ lobe roller deleted: stage 1 = a crowned 440C O1.5 pin (ISO 8734 1.5 m6 blank, ground crown) on the crank's short arm sliding in a 1.52 x 1.5 groove in hub 2's cap ring (sliding pair 2), stage 2 = the verified O2.5 nose in a two-walled swept-envelope slot (sliding pair 1). Lead record convention (its stage-1 roller was not a separate body / joint in the record): springs 1 -> 0, rolling 1 -> 0, sliding 1 -> 2, bought 15 -> 13 (- MR63ZZ, - clock spring, - stop-A dowel, + O1.5 pin) = 15.75 (lead 18.25 like-for-like). If the roller's spin is counted as the lead's 4th passive rotation / 8th joint, this design is 13.75.

verdict: VERIFIED 18.95 AS THE MODEL'S NUMBER, NOT AS A BUILDABLE DRIVE (lead note 2026-10-18 06:30 UTC; ledger final WATCH, skeptic 2026-10-18T06:26:41Z, audit 240ef8e / 135a278). Stage 1 (groove, ring and pin at F+0.60..2.10, short arm F-1.75..+0.35) sits inside link 1b's J2 lower plate (F+0..3), and every glev in the search box leaves it there. This model is the SOURCE of the desmo family's stage-1 level formula; desmo-conecut and lowarm-halfring inherit it. At the nearest plate-clearing level (F+3.9) the verified pin is dead (fast 101.19). Re-picked on fast (9.8/150), it reads 20.38 bench / 25.33 held (+1.43 / +1.43, in-band only). That is a LOWER BOUND, because the short arm stays inside the plate there. Also, the 'paired TIE' below was measured at the REFUTED placement 9.25/154 (18.63). At the verified config, paired against slipper-nose, the design is +0.46 bench / +0.45 held WORSE (p_A_better 0.0). slipper-nose is no longer the lead (conecut-knee 18.28). The declared 1.5 mm radius gate is silent: enforced, it would cut the verified claim (rc_min 0.90). | HISTORICAL TEXT: paired TIE with the lead at lower complexity: frozen exact Bench(110,360) 18.63 vs the lead's 18.49 through the same code (+0.14, all in-band), held 23.59 vs 23.45, reach / losses / contacts identical; complexity 15.75 vs 18.25 (no clock spring, cap, stop A or stage-1 roller; positive both ways, K never read). The spec's stage-1 placement (a_s 8.625, psi 184) FAILS its own determinacy: crank-free K play 1.12 deg in the dwell, 2.2-3.7 at the onset corner (the pin moves WITH the cap); re-placed at a_s 9.25 / psi 154 with a 10-deg q2 onset blend it holds K to 0.245 deg (nominal fit).
limiter: the lead's walls unchanged (fold 88 = stretched + folded, knee slide 9, contacts 237 / 264 on the lug and crank); the desmo's own: in-band (ring sector outside O20 at r 10-10.64, 9 samples 51 % in band, median 13.9 mm) and determinacy margin (crank-free K play 0.245 deg at c 0.01, 0.367 at c 0.015, 0.36 in series with the slot's 0.115; the onset corner needs a 10-deg q2 blend = up to 2.61 deg K lead the bench IK does not carry).
note: VERIFIED 2026-10-17 by an independent skeptic: v_gap 18.95 (score 93.11) frozen exact Bench(110,360) at the re-placed stage-1 pin (a_s 9.5, psi 150) with the groove's blended onset law in the IK; champion 75.94 on the same bench (risley-turret verifier checks; the lead's verification uses the same reference). Held 23.90. The claimed config (18.63, reproduced exactly; 18.59 with the blended IK) fails the claim's own 0.25-deg crank-free slop gate under a dense scan (0.273 at K 42, inside the taken range; centreline radius 0.37-0.63 < pin radius), so the verified number is the nearest placement that passes it (+0.36). Paired vs the lead slipper-nose 18.49 / 23.45: +0.46 / +0.45 all in-band, same poses and contacts. Prior note: UNVERIFIED self-claim. Verifier: retarget slipper-nose-knuckle-3r verifier at DSModel; put the blended onset law into the IK; re-measure crank-free play with tolerance; T5 dump. Cell B (pinned horn, deletes the lug band) not built - the only lever here that could beat a tie. Farm hit the 12-h budget line during the claims (balance $24.22, exo-cpu1 max 0); claims finished locally niced.
